name: Dependency graph and query Skill installation
summary: Installs two independent, bundled project Skills: graph generation and read-only graph querying, with explicit update confirmation and different packaging requirements.
limitations: Covers installation, bundle ownership and the installed Skills' distinct contracts, not a complete generator/condenser or query-command reference.
Tests were inspected, not run; no actual package build, consumer installation, graph generation or Agent-host Skill discovery was exercised.

facts.text: Knowledge: Install Dependency Graph Agent Skill and Knowledge: Install Graph Query Agent Skill are separate commands and Explorer title actions. Both use the first workspace root chosen during activation; in the no-workspace path they are placeholder commands that warn to open a folder.

AgentSkillService allows only vibeknowledge-dependency-graph and vibeknowledge-query. Generation assets come from extension/resources/skills; query assets come from extension/dist/skills. Both copy recursively to <workspace>/.agents/skills/<name>, returning the installed SKILL.md path. Installing one does not install the other.

Existing target directories trigger a modal Update/Cancel choice. On acceptance the service overwrites bundled files, then offers to open SKILL.md; errors are reported through localized messages. Installation itself copies assets, without executing graph generation, querying or MCP setup.

Installed means target-directory existence, not a version or integrity check, so a partial directory also requires update confirmation. Source SKILL.md is mandatory; query additionally requires scripts/query.cjs. Copying is direct per file, skips non-file/non-directory entries, and does not remove extra target files or provide transactional rollback of a partial copy.

The extension build calls buildQuerySkill to copy query instructions and bundle packages/mcp-server/src/queryCliEntry.ts into scripts/query.cjs. esbuild targets Node 26 CommonJS, resolves root zod, includes licenses and rejects bundles containing better-sqlite3, MCP SDK or Google dependencies. The root package declares esbuild ^0.28.2 and zod ^3.25.76.

The generation Skill's documented role is refreshing deterministic structural facts and focused framework/module/feature groups, validating manifests and rendering audit/context views. It keeps generated structure in sidecars and explicitly excludes writing graph.sqlite human overrides. Its scripts share the TypeScript extractor used by the extension's StructuralGraphService.

The query Skill runs with Node >=26.1 <27 and documents no npm install, MCP server or API-key prerequisite. The CLI validates command-specific flags with zod before file access. Context/impact/structural-path/structure read structural artifacts, while curated queries read AgentGraphStore and use AgentGraphQueryEngine; installation alone supplies none of those project graph artifacts.

Queries use existing snapshots, not a live generation service. Missing/corrupt graph artifacts fail explicitly. Optional human descriptions are read from graph.sqlite using built-in node:sqlite in read-only mode; absent databases/tables mean no overrides, while database errors are not silently discarded. The query Skill directs users to targeted source verification for stale facts and dynamic/configuration gaps.

AgentSkillService tests assert independent query installation, rejected unknown/partial bundles, recursive generation assets, explicit overwrite and recovery from partial target directories. Query integration tests build/copy the bundle and assert no node_modules dependency, Unicode/space paths, read-only graph queries, invalid-input failures and unchanged SQLite bytes when applying human prose.
